description: Source code for the Ethernet driver for W5500 chip using SPI interface in Zephyr RTOS, including SPI communication, buffer management, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: w5500_spi_read
methods.description: Reads data from W5500 via SPI at specified address.

methods.name: w5500_spi_write
methods.description: Writes data to W5500 via SPI at specified address.

methods.name: w5500_readbuf
methods.description: Reads buffer data from W5500 memory, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: w5500_writebuf
methods.description: Writes buffer data to W5500 memory, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: w5500_command
methods.description: Sends command to W5500 and waits for completion.

methods.name: w5500_tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet via W5500.

methods.name: w5500_rx
methods.description: Receives a network packet from W5500.

methods.name: w5500_thread
methods.description: Main thread handling W5500 interrupts and events.

methods.name: w5500_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of W5500 interface.

methods.name: w5500_set_config
methods.description: Configures W5500 device settings such as MAC address and promiscuous mode.

methods.name: w5500_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback for W5500 interrupt handling.

methods.name: w5500_set_macaddr
methods.description: Sets MAC address for W5500 device.

methods.name: w5500_memory_configure
methods.description: Configures RX and TX memory sizes for W5500.

methods.name: w5500_init
methods.description: Initializes W5500 device, including GPIO, SPI, and memory setup.
